verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS finance platform like Brex, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics, usage-tracking controls, or any opt-out setting; the docs cover APIs, webhooks, the MCP server and spend features only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
